_comment: Optional real photos for player cards, keyed by player id (the "id" field in the generated player_profiles.json — find a player's id there, not their name, since that file regenerates from the sheet). Add "<id>": "/players/<file>.jpg" here, with the image placed in public/players/, to show it instead of the initials avatar. Empty by default — this file is hand-edited and never touched by scripts/update_data.py.
